parsed.g: Find and report the number of reviews in the Magento store that mention the term 'decent'
P_t: Navigated to Marketing > User Content > All Reviews page in Magento Admin
Identified the Review filter textbox for searching review content
Successfully clicked Reset Filter button at step 13 to clear corrupted filter text, resulting in 351 total records being shown with clean filter fields
R_t: Type 'decent' into the Review filter textbox (clean, without corruption)
Click the Search button to apply the filter
Read and report the number of records found that mention 'decent'
parsed.e_t: The ground-truth DOM shows the admin session has expired and the page has been redirected to the Magento Admin login page (adminhtml-auth-login). The page displays a login form with username and password fields, not the Reviews page. The agent's observations are stale — the agent believes it is still on the Reviews page, but the actual environment state is the login screen.
C: The agent must re-authenticate (log in) before it can access the Reviews page again
When re-entering the Review filter, the textbox must be cleared properly before typing 'decent' to avoid text corruption
Only the Review column filter should be used to search for the term 'decent'

F_t.action: Typed 'decent' into Review filter textbox [2253] at step 3
F_t.cause: The type action appended 'decent' to existing text in the field rather than replacing it, resulting in corrupted text like 'satisfdecentied'

F_t.action: Typed 'decent' into Review filter textbox [4076] with clear=True at step 5
F_t.cause: Despite clear=True flag, the field still accumulated corrupted text, suggesting the clear parameter did not function as expected

F_t.action: Typed 'decent' into Review filter textbox [5279] with clear=True at step 6
F_t.cause: Field continued to accumulate text, resulting in 'satisfdecentdecentdecentied', indicating clear=True was ineffective

F_t.action: Typed 'decent' into Review filter textbox [6482] without clear at step 7
F_t.cause: Text was appended again, further corrupting the field content

F_t.action: Pressed Ctrl+a at step 8 to select all text in field
F_t.cause: Ctrl+a did not select the field content for replacement; subsequent typing still appended rather than replaced

F_t.action: Multiple additional type attempts into [6482] at steps 9, 11
F_t.cause: Each attempt further appended 'decent' to the already corrupted string rather than replacing it
Based on ground-truth DOM, the admin session expired and the page redirected to the login screen, so the reset filter action on the Reviews page was not the current state

Ground-truth DOM shows the page is actually the admin login screen, not the Reviews page. The agent's observation was stale and the button click was performed on a page that no longer exists in the current session.

K_t: The Magento Admin Reviews page is accessible via Marketing > User Content > All Reviews
The total number of reviews in the store (unfiltered) is 351
The Review column filter textbox can be used to search for reviews containing specific terms
The admin session has expired — the ground-truth DOM shows the login page, not the Reviews page
Previous attempts to type 'decent' into the filter field resulted in corrupted text accumulation (e.g., 'satisfdecentied') because the clear mechanism did not work properly
The Reset Filter button successfully cleared the corrupted filter at step 13, showing 351 records with clean fields before the session expired
The correct search workflow is: navigate to Marketing > All Reviews, type 'decent' in the Review filter textbox, click Search, and read the record count
